items.title: Multiple vulnerabilities in HPE Cray Servers Using Intel Processors
items.summary: Classification: Severe, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Not Defined, CVSSv3.1: 7.9, CVEs: CVE-2025-30513, CVE-2025-31944, CVE-2025-32007, CVE-2025-32467, CVE-2025-27572, CVE-2025-27940, Summary: Potential security vulnerabilities have been identified in HPE Cray servers using Intel processors could be locally exploited to allow escalation of privilege, denial of service, and information disclosure. For more information on this vulnerability, please see Intel Security Advisory INTEL-SA-01397, 2026.1 IPU, Intel Trust Domain Extensions (Intel TDX) module Advisory.

items.title: Multiple vulnerabilities in HPE Cray XD670 Server
items.summary:
Classification: Severe, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Not Defined, CVSSv3.1: 8.2, CVEs: CVE-2025-35991, CVE-2022-23932, Summary: CVE-2025-35991 (CVSS: 5.3): A potential security vulnerability in HPE Cray XD670 server using certain Intel processors could be locally exploited to allow disclosure of information. For more information on the vulnerability, please see Intel Security Advisory INTEL-SA-01413, UEFI Reference Firmware Advisory.

CVE-2022-23932 (CVSS: 8.2): Potential security vulnerabilities in HPE Cray XD670 server using AMI BIOS could be locally exploited to allow escalation of privilege, arbitrary code execution, unauthorized code execution, denial of service, and information disclosure. See also: https://support.hpe.com/hpesc/public/docDisplay?docId=hpesbhf05067en_us&docLocale=en_US

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in HPE Aruba Networking Private 5G Core
items.summary: Classification: Critical, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Not Defined, CVSSv3.1: 10.0, CVEs: CVE-2026-54763, CVE-2026-33377, Summary: HPE Aruba Networking has released a patch for HPE Aruba Networking Private 5G Core to address multiple security vulnerabilities in third-party components (Traefik and Grafana). These vulnerabilities could allow for authentication bypass or privilege escalation.
